gates.name: Test
gates.detail: dotnet test --no-build --configuration Release --verbosity normal: SubZeroDev.Platform.GameEdge.Tests Total tests: 19, Passed: 19; SubZeroDev.Platform.Tests Total tests: 372, Passed: 372.

gates.name: Run the sample in both roles
gates.reason: build/Test-SampleRoundTrip.ps1 is documented Linux-only: it P/Invokes libc's kill(2) to distinguish SIGTERM from SIGKILL, which has no Windows equivalent, and it shells out to sqlite3. This session ran on Windows. Both samples were exercised manually instead over real HTTP (dotnet run against SubZeroDev.Platform.Sample.Local and SubZeroDev.Platform.Sample.Web): GET / returned 200 on both, POST /orders on Sample.Web returned 200, GET /boom returned 500 with the envelope, and GET /health/ready returned 200 with every check healthy.

gates.name: Assert no framework project references a workload
gates.detail: pwsh ./build/Test-WorkloadIsolation.ps1: No project under src/ or samples/ references workloads/ (28 project file(s) checked).

gates.name: Typecheck
gates.detail: cd workloads/game-service && npm run typecheck: tsc reports errors in src/store.ts, src/conformance.ts, tests/row-guards.test.ts, tests/storage-seam.test.ts, tests/store.test.ts and tests/support/persistence-stub.ts, e.g. "src/store.ts(75,16): error TS2322: Type '2' is not assignable to type '1'." and "tests/storage-seam.test.ts(24,9): error TS2353: Object literal may only specify known properties, and 'listByProfile' does not exist in type 'SaveRecordStore'." This branch touches no file under workloads/game-service; git log shows src/store.ts last changed in commit 665103a (already on main, merged as #207), and the missing 'listByProfile'/'branch-session' surface matches this repository's own recorded gap (D5-S14/S15 must add list_saves, branch_session, delete_save for 13-op MCP catalogue parity) — pre-existing on main, not introduced here.

gates.name: Start the workload and the edge, the documented way
gates.detail: GAME_SERVICE_PORT=8080 npm start reached http://127.0.0.1:8080/livez and /readyz both {"status":"healthy"}. GameEdge run from workloads/game-edge/SubZeroDev.Platform.GameEdge/bin/Release/net10.0 with GameEdge__WorkloadBaseAddress=http://127.0.0.1:8080 ASPNETCORE_URLS=http://127.0.0.1:5080 reached http://127.0.0.1:5080/health/live {"status":"Healthy","checks":[]} and /health/ready {"status":"Healthy","checks":[{"name":"game-workload","status":"Healthy"},{"name":"platform.audit.sink","status":"Healthy"}]}. This also proves the I-R6 fix in workloads/game-edge/SubZeroDev.Platform.GameEdge/Endpoints.cs: the edge host starts and serves with the new startup check active.

gates.name: Run the replay against the edge
gates.detail: cd workloads/game-service && GAME_EDGE_DLL=<built edge dll> npx vitest run tests/replay-edge.test.ts: Test Files 1 failed (1), Tests 2 failed (2).
